working_title: Who Is Playing the Moonlight Drum? | Australian Animal Detective Story
format_family: connected Australian bush sound-and-track detective story
visual_system: integrated full-frame cinematic storybook bush mystery with visible clue actions and changing locations
interaction_style: follow one continuous trail, inspect physical evidence, pause to predict, then watch the animal perform the clue action

motion_personality.name: Playful
motion_personality.easing: ease-out-back for clue reveals; smooth ease-in-out for travel
motion_personality.transition_family: match cuts on footprint, leaf and moon shapes with hard action cuts
motion_hierarchy: hero: Kiri or the newly revealed animal visibly performs the story action
support: one physical clue moves or changes state
texture: subtle leaves, water or fireflies only
motion_personality.restraint: no whole-frame-only motion, no static choice cards, no repeated character pose, no decorative transition competing with the clue

cast.name: Kiri
cast.identity_lock: small warm-brown quokka, rounded ears, cream muzzle, teal neckerchief, round gold magnifying glass with leaf-detail handle and tiny ochre satchel

cast.name: Pippa
cast.identity_lock: chocolate-brown platypus, broad grey bill, webbed feet and plum rain scarf

cast.name: Edie
cast.identity_lock: small golden-brown echidna, cream-tipped spines and moss-green pouch

cast.name: Billie
cast.identity_lock: silver-grey bilby, very long pink-lined ears, black-and-white tail and yellow bandana

cast.name: Suki
cast.identity_lock: pearl-grey sugar glider, dark head stripe, visible gliding membrane and coral wrist ribbon

cast.name: Wally
cast.identity_lock: sturdy sandy-brown wombat, square nose, indigo waistcoat and two smooth wooden beaters

story_rule: Every clue must be caused by a visible animal action and advance the same mystery. Animals are helpers, never suspects accused of wrongdoing.

audio_rules.music: original playful 96 BPM marimba, pizzicato strings and gentle hand percussion; energy builds toward the clearing
audio_rules.effects: real water, sand, leaf, glide and hollow-log sounds synchronized only to visible actions
audio_rules.voice: natural, warm and clearly paced; no squeaky pitch warping and no spoken imitation of sound effects

scenes.location: Kiri's eucalyptus-map nook at blue-hour dusk
scenes.story_beat: A distant hollow-log rhythm interrupts Kiri's map sorting and begins one clear mystery.
narration: A bouncy rhythm rolled through the evening bush.
Who was playing the moonlight drum?
dialogue: Detective Kiri is on the trail!
scenes.primary_action: Kiri stops sorting maps, turns toward the sound, lifts the round gold magnifier and runs out along a newly trembling leaf trail
scenes.start_state: maps stacked, magnifier resting, Kiri seated
scenes.action_state: Kiri's ears turn, one map flutters and the magnifier rises
scenes.end_state: Kiri exits right with satchel and magnifier while the map nook remains behind

scenes.story_beat: Webbed prints and a widening ripple reveal Pippa Platypus, who heard the rhythm upstream.
narration: Webbed footprints crossed the creek mud.
dialogue: Pippa! The drummer went to the log.
scenes.primary_action: Kiri kneels to compare one print, the water ripple widens, then Pippa swims in and plants one matching webbed foot beside it
scenes.start_state: empty creek, one clear webbed print and small ripple
scenes.action_state: Kiri traces the print during a quiet prediction pause
scenes.end_state: Pippa stands beside her matching print and points toward the fallen log

scenes.location: fallen gum log and termite mound
scenes.story_beat: Fresh scratch marks and displaced bark reveal Edie Echidna searching for ants.
narration: Fresh scratches curled around the log.
dialogue: Edie! A bilby crossed the sand.
scenes.primary_action: Kiri follows the scratches, bark crumbs tumble, and Edie pushes out from behind the log before making one matching claw scratch
scenes.start_state: log with fresh marks, bark crumbs still
scenes.action_state: Kiri examines the marks during the prediction pause as crumbs begin to fall
scenes.end_state: Edie is fully visible with one claw beside the matching mark and points toward sandy scrub

scenes.location: silver spinifex and sandy burrow ridge
scenes.story_beat: Long narrow footprints and a freshly swept burrow reveal Billie Bilby.
narration: Long prints ended beside the burrow.
dialogue: Billie! A gliding shadow went upward.
scenes.primary_action: Kiri measures the long prints, sand spills from the burrow, and Billie hops out with ears rising into the moonlight
scenes.start_state: empty ridge, two long prints and closed-looking burrow shadow
scenes.action_state: Kiri compares the prints during the prediction pause while loose sand shifts
scenes.end_state: Billie stands in the exact final print with both long ears raised and looks toward the canopy

scenes.story_beat: A chewed blossom and a moving gliding shadow reveal Suki Sugar Glider.
narration: A shadow sailed between two trees.
dialogue: Suki! The rhythm comes from the clearing.
scenes.primary_action: Kiri looks up through the magnifier, Suki launches from one branch with membrane open and lands safely on a lower branch beside the blossom
scenes.start_state: two separated branches, blossom and distant shadow
scenes.action_state: Suki visibly glides across the gap during the prediction pause
scenes.end_state: Suki lands, folds her membrane and points toward the brighter clearing

scenes.story_beat: Kiri combines the helpers' directions into one route instead of guessing from another card.
narration: Every clue pointed the same way.
dialogue: All four clues connect. Follow me!
scenes.primary_action: Kiri places four physical clue tokens in route order, draws one continuous line through them, then leads the four helpers down the correct path
scenes.start_state: four clue tokens separated at the junction
scenes.action_state: Kiri moves the tokens into creek-log-burrow-canopy order during the pause
scenes.end_state: one glowing route line connects all four tokens and the group runs toward the clearing

scenes.location: moonlit clearing with one hollow log
scenes.story_beat: The mystery resolves: Wally Wombat is practicing a welcome rhythm for everyone.
narration: The trail ended at one hollow log.
A sturdy drummer lifted two wooden beaters.
dialogue: Wally Wombat! I made a welcome rhythm.
scenes.primary_action: Wally raises both beaters and performs a visible four-beat pattern on the hollow log as Kiri and the helpers arrive and react
scenes.start_state: Wally waits behind the silent log with beaters lowered
scenes.action_state: four distinct visible beater contacts create the real drum rhythm
scenes.end_state: Wally bows, Kiri closes the solved casebook and every helper gathers around the log

scenes.location: same clearing, now a small moonlight animal parade
scenes.story_beat: Every clue action becomes part of the final rhythm and the mystery closes with a earned celebration.
narration: Steps, claws, ears and gliding joined in.
scenes.primary_action: Pippa steps, Edie taps, Billie bounces, Suki glides and Wally drums in a readable sequence while Kiri stamps the case solved
scenes.start_state: animals wait in a semicircle around the log
scenes.action_state: each animal performs its unique clue action once in sequence
scenes.end_state: final four seconds hold the completed group tableau with CASE SOLVED title only

thumbnail.composition: Kiri in foreground with leaf magnifier, one luminous trail leading to Wally's partly revealed hollow log, four helper silhouettes readable but secondary
thumbnail.avoid: no collage grid, no answer text, no more than one drum and two beaters
